php.title: Sign In - Barangay Health Center Survey System
php.text:
RESIDENT & STAFF PORTAL

Barangay Health Center Survey System

A web-based survey platform for the Barangay Health Center. Residents can answer surveys while authorised staff can manage residents, surveys, and results.

One login for residents and health center personnel
Your account type is detected automatically
Works across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
Sign in

Enter your Resident Number or staff username.

Username / Resident Number *
Password *
Log In

Forgot your password? Visit the Barangay Health Center and ask staff to reset it. Residents bring a valid ID; staff accounts are reset by the administrator.

Residents use the Resident Number issued by the health center. Staff use the username assigned by the administrator. New accounts start with a temporary password and are prompted to set their own on first login.

About
Features

Your Health Records, Simplified

Access and update your personal and family health information securely. Manage documents, track surveys, and stay connected with your barangay health center—all from home.

24/7
Access Anytime
100%
Secure
0min
Wait Time
Smart Records Management

Digital health profiles for you and your family, verified by our health staff.

WHY CHOOSE THIS SYSTEM
Built for Convenience & Security
Complete Family Profiles

Manage health records for yourself, spouse, children, and extended family all in one place.

Staff-Verified Updates

Every change is reviewed and approved by certified health center staff before taking effect.

Survey Participation

Respond to health surveys at your convenience and view historical data instantly.

Always Available

Access your records 24/7 from any device. No more long waits at the health center.

Encrypted & Protected

CAPABILITIES
Everything You Need
Personal Information

Update your address, contact details, employment status, and family composition anytime.

Health Records

Upload and manage medical documents, vaccination records, and health history.

Survey Response

Complete health surveys and view results in real-time from your dashboard.

Household Management

Add family members, manage household information, and keep records unified.

Mobile Friendly

Access your account seamlessly on your phone, tablet, or computer.

Instant Updates

Changes are processed quickly with staff approval notifications sent to you.

About Us

We are a community-focused team building simple, secure tools for barangay health centers. Our system helps staff manage resident records, run surveys, and provide timely care. We partner with local health workers to keep data accurate and respect patient privacy.

Careers

We're a small, growing team. Open roles: Frontend Developer, Community Coordinator, and Support Specialist. If you're passionate about public health tech, email us at jobs@barangayhealth.example with your resume.

Contact Us

For general inquiries, call +63 2 5555 0123 or email info@barangayhealth.example. You can also visit your local barangay health center during working hours.

        function setupReveal() {
            const reveals = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'));
            if (!reveals.length) return;
            const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                    const el = entry.target;
                    const delay = parseInt(el.dataset.delay || '0', 10);
                    el.style.transitionDelay = (delay ? delay + 'ms' : '0ms');
                    el.classList.add('is-visible');
                    observer.unobserve(el);
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' });
            reveals.forEach((r) => obs.observe(r));
        }
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupReveal); else setupReveal();

        function setupReveal() {
            const reveals = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'));
            if (!reveals.length) return;
            const obs = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
                    const el = entry.target;
                    const delay = parseInt(el.dataset.delay || '0', 10);
                    el.style.transitionDelay = (delay ? delay + 'ms' : '0ms');
                    el.classList.add('is-visible');
                    observer.unobserve(el);
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px' });
            reveals.forEach((r) => obs.observe(r));
        }
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupReveal); else setupReveal();
    })();

    var other = document.querySelector('[data-title-other]');

    function sync() {
        var custom = select.value === 'Others';
        other.hidden = !custom;
        var input = other.querySelector('input');
        if (input) { input.required = custom; }

    select.addEventListener('change', sync);

})();

        setValueIfPresent('edit_occupation', resident.occupation);

        function applyTitle(select, otherBox, stored) {
            if (!select) { return; }
            stored = stored || '';
            var known = Array.prototype.some.call(select.options, function (o) {
                return o.value === stored && o.value !== 'Others';

        function setChoice(name, on) {

            var radios = infoModal
                ? infoModal.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name="' + name + '"]')

            radios.forEach(function (radio) {

           row is kept as the template and cloned, so the markup only has to be
           right in the PHP that rendered it. An empty set still leaves one
           blank row to type into. */
        function fillPersonRows(field, rows) {
            var group = infoModal
                ? infoModal.querySelector('[data-person-rows="' + field + '"]')
                : null;
            if (!group) { return; }

            var template = group.querySelector('[data-person-row]');
            if (!template) { return; }

            var blank = template.cloneNode(true);
            // Selects as well as inputs: courtesy title and gender are
            // dropdowns, and clearing only the text boxes would leave a
            // previous person's title stuck on a fresh row.
            blank.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(function (control) {
                control.value = '';
            });

            group.innerHTML = '';
            var list = (rows && rows.length) ? rows : [null];

            list.forEach(function (row, index) {
                var copy = blank.cloneNode(true);
                copy.querySelectorAll('input[name], select[name]').forEach(function (control) {
                    control.name = control.name.replace(/^\w+\[\d+\]/, field + '[' + index + ']');
                    var part = control.name.replace(/^.*\[(\w+)\]$/, '$1');

                    // The "Others" box is filled by applyTitle below, not from
                    // a stored field of its own — there is no such column.
                    if (part === 'courtesy_title_other') { return; }

                    control.value = row && row[part] ? row[part] : '';
                });

                /* Append before restoring the title. applyTitle fires a change
                   event, and the handler that shows or hides the "Others" box
                   is delegated from the document — a row still detached from
                   the page never reaches it, which left the box holding a
                   value while staying hidden. */
                group.appendChild(copy);

                var rowTitle = copy.querySelector('[data-title-select]');
                if (rowTitle) {
                    applyTitle(rowTitle, copy.querySelector('[data-title-other]'), row ? row.courtesy_title : '');
                }
            });

            if (window.renumberPersonRows) {
                window.renumberPersonRows(group);
            }
        }

        fillPersonRows('children', resident.children);

// Auto-fill the read-only Age field from the selected birthdate.
// Age is display-only and never submitted — it is always derived
// from birthdate so it cannot go stale in the database.
(function () {
    function computeAge(value) {
        if (!value) { return ''; }
        var parts = value.split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) { return ''; }

        var born = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        if (isNaN(born.getTime())) { return ''; }

        var today = new Date();
        if (born > today) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }

        var age = today.getFullYear() - born.getFullYear();
        var monthDiff = today.getMonth() - born.getMonth();

        // Subtract a year if this year's birthday has not happened yet
        if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < born.getDate())) {
            age = age - 1;
        }

        if (age < 0) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }
        return age === 1 ? '1 year old' : age + ' years old';
    }

    function updateAddAgeDisplay() {
        var birthdateInput = document.getElementById('birthdate');
        var ageField = document.getElementById('age_display');
        if (!birthdateInput || !ageField) { return; }
        ageField.value = computeAge(birthdateInput.value);
    }

    function updateEditAgeDisplay() {
        var birthdateInput = document.getElementById('edit_birthdate');
        var ageField = document.getElementById('edit_age_display');
        if (!birthdateInput || !ageField) { return; }
        ageField.value = computeAge(birthdateInput.value);
    }

    window.updateEditAgeDisplay = updateEditAgeDisplay;

    var addBirthdateInput = document.getElementById('birthdate');
    if (addBirthdateInput) {
        addBirthdateInput.addEventListener('change', updateAddAgeDisplay);
        addBirthdateInput.addEventListener('input', updateAddAgeDisplay);
        updateAddAgeDisplay();
    }

    var editBirthdateInput = document.getElementById('edit_birthdate');
    if (editBirthdateInput) {
        editBirthdateInput.addEventListener('change', updateEditAgeDisplay);
        editBirthdateInput.addEventListener('input', updateEditAgeDisplay);
        updateEditAgeDisplay();
    }
})();

(function () {
    // "Others" hands the title to a free-text box.
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-title-select]').forEach(function (select) {
        var scope = select.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var other = scope.querySelector('[data-title-other]');
        if (!other) { return; }

        function sync() {
            var custom = select.value === 'Others';
            other.hidden = !custom;
            var input = other.querySelector('input');
            if (input) {
                input.required = custom;
                if (!custom) { input.value = ''; }
            }
        }
        select.addEventListener('change', sync);
        sync();
    });

    // ---------- Residency length ----------
    // Shows the years/months/days total as soon as a date is picked, and warns
    // when Permanent is chosen too early. The server re-checks this; the
    // message here just saves the staff member a round trip.
    var MIN_MONTHS = 6;

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-residency-start]').forEach(function (dateField) {
        var scope = dateField.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var status = scope.querySelector('[name="residency_status"]');
        var badge = scope.querySelector('#edit-residency-badge');
        var note = scope.querySelector('[data-residency-note]');
        if (!note) { return; }
        if (!status && !badge) { return; }

        // Add Resident has a dropdown; Edit Resident shows a read-only badge,
        // because the status there is only changed through the Make Permanent
        // / Revert button. Either way this needs to know which status applies.
        function currentStatus() {
            if (status) { return status.value; }
            return badge.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'temporary' ? 'temporary' : 'permanent';
        }

        function describe(start, today) {
            var years = today.getFullYear() - start.getFullYear();
            var months = today.getMonth() - start.getMonth();
            var days = today.getDate() - start.getDate();

            if (days < 0) {
                months--;
                days += new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
            }
            if (months < 0) {
                years--;
                months += 12;
            }

            var parts = [];
            if (years)  { parts.push(years + ' year' + (years === 1 ? '' : 's')); }
            if (months) { parts.push(months + ' month' + (months === 1 ? '' : 's')); }
            if (days)   { parts.push(days + ' day' + (days === 1 ? '' : 's')); }

            return {
                totalMonths: years * 12 + months,
                text: parts.length ? parts.join(', ') : 'less than a day'
            };
        }

        function sync() {
            note.classList.remove('field-hint-warning');

            if (!dateField.value) {
                note.textContent = 'Permanent status requires at least ' + MIN_MONTHS + ' months of residence.';
                dateField.setCustomValidity('');
                return;
            }

            var start = new Date(dateField.value + 'T00:00:00');
            var today = new Date();
            today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

            if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || start > today) {
                note.textContent = 'Pick a date that is not in the future.';
                note.classList.add('field-hint-warning');
                dateField.setCustomValidity('The residency start date cannot be in the future.');
                return;
            }

            var span = describe(start, today);

            if (currentStatus() === 'permanent' && span.totalMonths < MIN_MONTHS) {
                note.textContent = 'Residing here for ' + span.text + '. That is under the '
                    + MIN_MONTHS + '-month minimum, so this person cannot be recorded as Permanent yet.'
                    + ' Choose Temporary and change the status later.';
                note.classList.add('field-hint-warning');
                dateField.setCustomValidity('A permanent resident needs at least ' + MIN_MONTHS + ' months of residence.');
            } else {
                note.textContent = 'Residing here for ' + span.text + '.';
                dateField.setCustomValidity('');
            }
        }

        dateField.addEventListener('change', sync);
        dateField.addEventListener('input', sync);
        if (status) { status.addEventListener('change', sync); }
        sync();
    });

    // ---------- Special category reference ----------
    // PWD, Senior Citizen and Pregnant each need a different supporting
    // number. The field is required only while one of them is selected, so
    // the browser never blocks a submit on a hidden input.
    var REFERENCE_FIELDS = {"pwd":{"label":"PWD ID Number","placeholder":"03-1408-000-0000123","format":"Format: RR-PPMM-BBB-NNNNNNN","hint":"Region, province and municipality, barangay, then the serial. Example: 03-1408-000-0000123. Copy it from the PWD identification card.","pattern":"\\d{2}-\\d{4}-\\d{3}-\\d{7}","error":"A PWD ID Number looks like 03-1408-000-0000123 (RR-PPMM-BBB-NNNNNNN)."},"senior_citizen":{"label":"Senior Citizen ID Number","placeholder":"SC-26-004512","format":"Format: SC-00-000000","hint":"From the OSCA-issued Senior Citizen card. Example: SC-26-004512.","pattern":"SC-\\d{2}-\\d{6}","error":"A Senior Citizen ID Number looks like SC-26-004512 (SC-00-000000)."},"pregnant":{"label":"Doctor\u0027s License Number","placeholder":"PRC No. 123456","format":"Format: PRC No. 000000","hint":"On a prescription pad or medical certificate this is labelled \u0022PRC No.\u0022, \u0022License No.\u0022 or \u0022PRC License No.\u0022 Example: PRC No. 123456.","pattern":"(?:(?:PRC|License|PRC License)\\s*(?:No\\.?|Number)?\\s*)?\\d{6,7}","error":"A doctor\u0027s licence number is six or seven digits, e.g. PRC No. 123456."}};

    document.querySelectorAll('[name="special_category"]').forEach(function (select) {
        var scope = select.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var box = scope.querySelector('[data-category-reference]');
        if (!box) { return; }

        var label = box.querySelector('[data-reference-label]');
        var input = box.querySelector('[data-reference-input]');
        var format = box.querySelector('[data-reference-format]');
        var hint = box.querySelector('[data-reference-hint]');

        function sync() {
            var spec = REFERENCE_FIELDS[select.value];
            if (!spec) {
                box.style.display = 'none';
                input.required = false;
                input.removeAttribute('pattern');
                input.value = '';
                if (format) { format.textContent = ''; }
                return;
            }
            box.style.display = 'block';
            label.innerHTML = spec.label + ' <span class="req">*</span>';
            input.placeholder = spec.placeholder;
            input.required = true;

            // The format sits directly under the box, the explanation below it.
            if (format) { format.textContent = spec.format; }
            hint.textContent = spec.hint;

            if (spec.pattern) {
                input.setAttribute('pattern', spec.pattern);
                input.title = spec.error;
            } else {
                input.removeAttribute('pattern');
            }
        }

        select.addEventListener('change', sync);
        sync();
    });

    // Temporary residence only applies to a temporary resident.
    document.querySelectorAll('[name="residency_status"]').forEach(function (status) {
        var scope = status.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var block = scope.querySelector('[data-temp-block]');
        if (!block) { return; }

        function sync() {
            var temporary = status.value === 'temporary';
            block.hidden = !temporary;

            // Disabling matters as much as hiding: a hidden `required` field
            // blocks submission with a validation message nobody can see, and
            // a disabled field posts nothing for a permanent resident.
            block.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(function (field) {
                field.disabled = !temporary;
                var label = field.previousElementSibling;
                var isRequired = label && label.querySelector && label.querySelector('.req');
                field.required = temporary && !!isRequired;
            });
        }
        status.addEventListener('change', sync);
        sync();
    });
})();

    // Must match address_field_names() in config/functions.php.
    var ADDRESS_FIELDS = ['household_number', 'purok', 'street_highway', 'barangay', 'municipality', 'postal_code', 'province'];

    function setValueIfPresent(id, value) {
        var field = document.getElementById(id);
        if (field) {
            field.value = value || '';
        }
    }

    function showEditFormForResident(residentId) {
        var resident = residentLookup[residentId];
        if (!resident) {
            alert('The selected resident could not be loaded.');
            return;
        }

        document.querySelector('#edit-resident-info-modal input[name="resident_id"]').value = resident.resident_id;
        setValueIfPresent('edit_first_name', resident.first_name);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_middle_name', resident.middle_name);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_last_name', resident.last_name);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_name_extension', resident.name_extension);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_email', resident.email);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_contact_number', resident.contact_number);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_birthdate', resident.birthdate);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_birthplace', resident.birthplace);
        // Address comes straight from the stored columns. The old code split
        // resident.address on commas and filled by position, which put the
        // wrong text in every box whenever the comma count differed.
        ADDRESS_FIELDS.forEach(function (field) {
            setValueIfPresent('edit_' + field, resident[field]);
            setValueIfPresent('edit_temp_' + field, resident['temp_' + field]);
        });
        setValueIfPresent('edit_residence_type', resident.residence_type);

        var titleField = document.getElementById('edit_courtesy_title');
        var titleOtherInput = document.getElementById('edit_courtesy_title_other');
        if (titleField) {
            var stored = resident.courtesy_title || '';
            var known = Array.prototype.some.call(titleField.options, function (o) {
                return o.value === stored && o.value !== 'Others';
            });
            // A title we do not offer as an option came from "Others", so
            // restore it into the free-text box rather than losing it.
            titleField.value = stored === '' ? '' : (known ? stored : 'Others');
            if (titleOtherInput) { titleOtherInput.value = known ? '' : stored; }
            titleField.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        }

        var genderField = document.getElementById('edit_gender');
        if (genderField) {
            genderField.value = resident.gender || '';
        }
        var specialCategoryField = document.getElementById('edit_special_category');
        if (specialCategoryField) {
            specialCategoryField.value = resident.special_category || 'none';
        }
        var categorySelect = document.getElementById('edit_special_category');
        var categoryRef = document.getElementById('edit_category_reference');
        if (categorySelect) {
            categorySelect.value = resident.special_category || 'none';
            if (categoryRef) { categoryRef.value = resident.category_reference || ''; }
            categorySelect.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        }

        var residencyStartField = document.getElementById('edit_residency_start_date');
        if (residencyStartField) {
            residencyStartField.value = resident.residency_start_date || '';
            residencyStartField.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        }

        /*
         * Residency status is read-only in this form, so there is no field to
         * set — the badge is filled in from the saved record, and the
         * temporary address block is shown or hidden to match it.
         *
         * The shared toggle further down keys off [name="residency_status"],
         * which the edit form no longer has, so the same show/hide and
         * enable/disable work is done here against the saved value. Disabling
         * matters as much as hiding: a hidden `required` field blocks
         * submission with a message nobody can see.
         */
        var savedStatus = resident.residency_status === 'temporary' ? 'temporary' : 'permanent';
        var isTemporary = savedStatus === 'temporary';

        var residencyBadge = document.getElementById('edit-residency-badge');
        if (residencyBadge) {
            residencyBadge.textContent = isTemporary ? 'Temporary' : 'Permanent';
            residencyBadge.classList.toggle('badge-temporary', isTemporary);
            residencyBadge.classList.toggle('badge-permanent', !isTemporary);
        }

        var editModal = document.getElementById('edit-resident-info-modal');
        var editTempBlock = editModal ? editModal.querySelector('[data-temp-block]') : null;
        if (editTempBlock) {
            editTempBlock.hidden = !isTemporary;
            editTempBlock.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(function (field) {
                field.disabled = !isTemporary;
                var label = field.previousElementSibling;
                var isRequired = label && label.querySelector && label.querySelector('.req');
                field.required = isTemporary && !!isRequired;
            });
        }

        // The residency switch reads the status the resident is SAVED with,
        // not whatever the dropdown currently shows, because it acts on the
        // stored record.
        var switchBox = document.getElementById('residency-switch');
        if (switchBox) {
            var switchBtn = document.getElementById('residency-switch-btn');
            var switchNote = document.getElementById('residency-switch-note');
            var saved = resident.residency_status || 'permanent';
            var hasTemp = !!(resident.temp_household_number || resident.temporary_address);

            switchBox.style.display = 'block';
            switchBtn.dataset.residentId = resident.resident_id;
            switchBtn.dataset.residentName =
                ((resident.first_name || '') + ' ' + (resident.last_name || '')).trim();
            switchBtn.dataset.currentAddress = resident.address || '';
            switchBtn.dataset.tempAddress = resident.temporary_address || '';

            if (saved === 'permanent') {
                switchBtn.textContent = 'Revert to Temporary Resident';
                switchBtn.dataset.action = 'revert';
                switchBtn.disabled = false;
                switchNote.textContent = 'Currently Permanent. Reverting restores the address archived when they were made permanent.';
            } else {
                switchBtn.textContent = 'Make Permanent Resident';
                switchBtn.dataset.action = 'promote';
                switchBtn.disabled = !hasTemp;
                switchNote.textContent = hasTemp
                    ? 'Currently Temporary. Their temporary address becomes their permanent one, and the current address is archived.'
                    : 'Currently Temporary. Add a temporary address first - there is nothing to promote.';
            }
        }

        /* ---------- Family and household details ----------
           These were not filled in at all, so every Edit opened with the
           whole section blank: occupation and hotline empty, the marital
           answer stuck on No, and no child or reference rows however many
           the resident had on file. Saving then failed on the required
           character reference for a resident who already had one. */
        setValueIfPresent('edit_occupation', resident.occupation);
        setValueIfPresent('edit_hotline_number', resident.hotline_number);

        /* Put a stored title back on a select that may not offer it.
           Anything typed through "Others" — Engr., Atty., Dr. — is not one of
           the four listed options, so assigning it directly would leave the
           select blank and quietly lose the title on the next save. */
        function applyTitle(select, otherBox, stored) {
            if (!select) { return; }
            stored = stored || '';
            var known = Array.prototype.some.call(select.options, function (o) {
                return o.value === stored && o.value !== 'Others';
            });
            select.value = stored === '' ? '' : (known ? stored : 'Others');
            if (otherBox) {
                otherBox.value = known || stored === '' ? '' : stored;
            }
            select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        }

        ['spouse', 'father', 'mother'].forEach(function (who) {
            ['last_name', 'first_name', 'middle_name', 'name_extension', 'gender'].forEach(function (part) {
                setValueIfPresent('edit_' + who + '_' + part, resident[who + '_' + part]);
            });
            applyTitle(
                document.getElementById('edit_' + who + '_courtesy_title'),
                document.getElementById('edit_' + who + '_courtesy_title_other'),
                resident[who + '_courtesy_title']
            );
        });

        // Tick the saved answer, then let the change handler show or hide the
        // block behind it. Setting .checked alone leaves the block out of step.
        function setChoice(name, on) {
            var wanted = String(on) === '1' ? '1' : '0';
            var radios = infoModal
                ? infoModal.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"][name="' + name + '"]')
                : [];
            radios.forEach(function (radio) {
                radio.checked = radio.value === wanted;
            });
            if (radios.length) {
                radios[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
            }
        }

        setChoice('is_married', Number(resident.is_married) === 1 ? '1' : '0');
        setChoice('has_children', Number(resident.has_children) === 1 ? '1' : '0');

        /* Rebuild a repeatable set of names from the stored rows. The first
           row is kept as the template and cloned, so the markup only has to be
           right in the PHP that rendered it. An empty set still leaves one
           blank row to type into. */
        function fillPersonRows(field, rows) {
            var group = infoModal
                ? infoModal.querySelector('[data-person-rows="' + field + '"]')
                : null;
            if (!group) { return; }

            var template = group.querySelector('[data-person-row]');
            if (!template) { return; }

            var blank = template.cloneNode(true);
            // Selects as well as inputs: courtesy title and gender are
            // dropdowns, and clearing only the text boxes would leave a
            // previous person's title stuck on a fresh row.
            blank.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(function (control) {
                control.value = '';
            });

            group.innerHTML = '';
            var list = (rows && rows.length) ? rows : [null];

            list.forEach(function (row, index) {
                var copy = blank.cloneNode(true);
                copy.querySelectorAll('input[name], select[name]').forEach(function (control) {
                    control.name = control.name.replace(/^\w+\[\d+\]/, field + '[' + index + ']');
                    var part = control.name.replace(/^.*\[(\w+)\]$/, '$1');
                    control.disabled = false;

                    // The "Others" box is filled by applyTitle below, not from
                    // a stored field of its own — there is no such column.
                    if (part === 'courtesy_title_other') { return; }

                    control.value = row && row[part] ? row[part] : '';
                });

                /* Append before restoring the title. applyTitle fires a change
                   event, and the handler that shows or hides the "Others" box
                   is delegated from the document — a row still detached from
                   the page never reaches it, which left the box holding a
                   value while staying hidden. */
                group.appendChild(copy);

                var rowTitle = copy.querySelector('[data-title-select]');
                if (rowTitle) {
                    applyTitle(rowTitle, copy.querySelector('[data-title-other]'), row ? row.courtesy_title : '');
                }
            });

            if (window.renumberPersonRows) {
                window.renumberPersonRows(group);
            }
        }

        fillPersonRows('children', resident.children);
        fillPersonRows('references', resident.references);

        if (chooserModal) {
            chooserModal.classList.remove('active');
        }
        if (infoModal) {
            infoModal.classList.add('active');
        }

        if (window.updateEditAgeDisplay) {
            window.updateEditAgeDisplay();
        }
    }

    if (selectResident && loadEditResidentBtn) {
        loadEditResidentBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (!selectResident.value) {
                alert('Please choose a resident ID first.');
                return;
            }

            showEditFormForResident(parseInt(selectResident.value, 10));
        });
    }

    // Edit directly from the resident's table row.
    document.querySelectorAll('.edit-resident-row').forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function () {
            showEditFormForResident(parseInt(button.getAttribute('data-resident-edit'), 10));
        });
    });
})();



// Auto-fill the read-only Age field from the selected birthdate.
// Age is display-only and never submitted — it is always derived
// from birthdate so it cannot go stale in the database.
(function () {
    function computeAge(value) {
        if (!value) { return ''; }
        var parts = value.split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) { return ''; }

        var born = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        if (isNaN(born.getTime())) { return ''; }

        var today = new Date();
        if (born > today) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }

        var age = today.getFullYear() - born.getFullYear();
        var monthDiff = today.getMonth() - born.getMonth();

        // Subtract a year if this year's birthday has not happened yet
        if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < born.getDate())) {
            age = age - 1;
        }

        if (age < 0) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }
        return age === 1 ? '1 year old' : age + ' years old';
    }

    function updateAddAgeDisplay() {
        var birthdateInput = document.getElementById('birthdate');
        var ageField = document.getElementById('age_display');
        if (!birthdateInput || !ageField) { return; }
        ageField.value = computeAge(birthdateInput.value);
    }

    function updateEditAgeDisplay() {
        var birthdateInput = document.getElementById('edit_birthdate');
        var ageField = document.getElementById('edit_age_display');
        if (!birthdateInput || !ageField) { return; }
        ageField.value = computeAge(birthdateInput.value);
    }

    window.updateEditAgeDisplay = updateEditAgeDisplay;

    var addBirthdateInput = document.getElementById('birthdate');
    if (addBirthdateInput) {
        addBirthdateInput.addEventListener('change', updateAddAgeDisplay);
        addBirthdateInput.addEventListener('input', updateAddAgeDisplay);
        updateAddAgeDisplay();
    }

    var editBirthdateInput = document.getElementById('edit_birthdate');
    if (editBirthdateInput) {
        editBirthdateInput.addEventListener('change', updateEditAgeDisplay);
        editBirthdateInput.addEventListener('input', updateEditAgeDisplay);
        updateEditAgeDisplay();
    }
})();

(function () {
    var modal = document.getElementById('request-delete-modal');

    var target = document.getElementById('request-delete-target');
    var idField = document.getElementById('request-delete-id');
    var reason = document.getElementById('reason');

        idField.value = trigger.getAttribute('data-resident-id');

            trigger.getAttribute('data-resident-name') +
            ' (' + trigger.getAttribute('data-resident-number') + ').';

})();



/**
 * Courtesy title "Others", and the temporary-residence block.
 *
 * Both add and edit modals use the same data- attributes, so this runs per
 * modal rather than per element ID.
 */
(function () {
    // "Others" hands the title to a free-text box.
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-title-select]').forEach(function (select) {
        var scope = select.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var other = scope.querySelector('[data-title-other]');
        if (!other) { return; }

        function sync() {
            var custom = select.value === 'Others';
            other.hidden = !custom;
            var input = other.querySelector('input');
            if (input) {
                input.required = custom;
                if (!custom) { input.value = ''; }
            }
        }
        select.addEventListener('change', sync);
        sync();
    });

    // ---------- Residency length ----------
    // Shows the years/months/days total as soon as a date is picked, and warns
    // when Permanent is chosen too early. The server re-checks this; the
    // message here just saves the staff member a round trip.
    var MIN_MONTHS = 6;

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-residency-start]').forEach(function (dateField) {
        var scope = dateField.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var status = scope.querySelector('[name="residency_status"]');
        var badge = scope.querySelector('#edit-residency-badge');
        var note = scope.querySelector('[data-residency-note]');
        if (!note) { return; }
        if (!status && !badge) { return; }

        // Add Resident has a dropdown; Edit Resident shows a read-only badge,
        // because the status there is only changed through the Make Permanent
        // / Revert button. Either way this needs to know which status applies.
        function currentStatus() {
            if (status) { return status.value; }
            return badge.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'temporary' ? 'temporary' : 'permanent';
        }

        function describe(start, today) {
            var years = today.getFullYear() - start.getFullYear();
            var months = today.getMonth() - start.getMonth();
            var days = today.getDate() - start.getDate();

            if (days < 0) {
                months--;
                days += new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
            }
            if (months < 0) {
                years--;
                months += 12;
            }

            var parts = [];
            if (years)  { parts.push(years + ' year' + (years === 1 ? '' : 's')); }
            if (months) { parts.push(months + ' month' + (months === 1 ? '' : 's')); }
            if (days)   { parts.push(days + ' day' + (days === 1 ? '' : 's')); }

            return {
                totalMonths: years * 12 + months,
                text: parts.length ? parts.join(', ') : 'less than a day'
            };
        }

        function sync() {
            note.classList.remove('field-hint-warning');

            if (!dateField.value) {
                note.textContent = 'Permanent status requires at least ' + MIN_MONTHS + ' months of residence.';
                dateField.setCustomValidity('');
                return;
            }

            var start = new Date(dateField.value + 'T00:00:00');
            var today = new Date();
            today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

            if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || start > today) {
                note.textContent = 'Pick a date that is not in the future.';
                note.classList.add('field-hint-warning');
                dateField.setCustomValidity('The residency start date cannot be in the future.');
                return;
            }

            var span = describe(start, today);

            if (currentStatus() === 'permanent' && span.totalMonths < MIN_MONTHS) {
                note.textContent = 'Residing here for ' + span.text + '. That is under the '
                    + MIN_MONTHS + '-month minimum, so this person cannot be recorded as Permanent yet.'
                    + ' Choose Temporary and change the status later.';
                note.classList.add('field-hint-warning');
                dateField.setCustomValidity('A permanent resident needs at least ' + MIN_MONTHS + ' months of residence.');
            } else {
                note.textContent = 'Residing here for ' + span.text + '.';
                dateField.setCustomValidity('');
            }
        }

        dateField.addEventListener('change', sync);
        dateField.addEventListener('input', sync);
        if (status) { status.addEventListener('change', sync); }
        sync();
    });

    // ---------- Special category reference ----------
    // PWD, Senior Citizen and Pregnant each need a different supporting
    // number. The field is required only while one of them is selected, so
    // the browser never blocks a submit on a hidden input.
    var REFERENCE_FIELDS = {"pwd":{"label":"PWD ID Number","placeholder":"03-1408-000-0000123","format":"Format: RR-PPMM-BBB-NNNNNNN","hint":"Region, province and municipality, barangay, then the serial. Example: 03-1408-000-0000123. Copy it from the PWD identification card.","pattern":"\\d{2}-\\d{4}-\\d{3}-\\d{7}","error":"A PWD ID Number looks like 03-1408-000-0000123 (RR-PPMM-BBB-NNNNNNN)."},"senior_citizen":{"label":"Senior Citizen ID Number","placeholder":"SC-26-004512","format":"Format: SC-00-000000","hint":"From the OSCA-issued Senior Citizen card. Example: SC-26-004512.","pattern":"SC-\\d{2}-\\d{6}","error":"A Senior Citizen ID Number looks like SC-26-004512 (SC-00-000000)."},"pregnant":{"label":"Doctor\u0027s License Number","placeholder":"PRC No. 123456","format":"Format: PRC No. 000000","hint":"On a prescription pad or medical certificate this is labelled \u0022PRC No.\u0022, \u0022License No.\u0022 or \u0022PRC License No.\u0022 Example: PRC No. 123456.","pattern":"(?:(?:PRC|License|PRC License)\\s*(?:No\\.?|Number)?\\s*)?\\d{6,7}","error":"A doctor\u0027s licence number is six or seven digits, e.g. PRC No. 123456."}};

    document.querySelectorAll('[name="special_category"]').forEach(function (select) {
        var scope = select.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var box = scope.querySelector('[data-category-reference]');
        if (!box) { return; }

        var label = box.querySelector('[data-reference-label]');
        var input = box.querySelector('[data-reference-input]');
        var format = box.querySelector('[data-reference-format]');
        var hint = box.querySelector('[data-reference-hint]');

        function sync() {
            var spec = REFERENCE_FIELDS[select.value];
            if (!spec) {
                box.style.display = 'none';
                input.required = false;
                input.removeAttribute('pattern');
                input.value = '';
                if (format) { format.textContent = ''; }
                return;
            }
            box.style.display = 'block';
            label.innerHTML = spec.label + ' <span class="req">*</span>';
            input.placeholder = spec.placeholder;
            input.required = true;

            // The format sits directly under the box, the explanation below it.
            if (format) { format.textContent = spec.format; }
            hint.textContent = spec.hint;

            if (spec.pattern) {
                input.setAttribute('pattern', spec.pattern);
                input.title = spec.error;
            } else {
                input.removeAttribute('pattern');
            }
        }

        select.addEventListener('change', sync);
        sync();
    });

    // Temporary residence only applies to a temporary resident.
    document.querySelectorAll('[name="residency_status"]').forEach(function (status) {
        var scope = status.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var block = scope.querySelector('[data-temp-block]');
        if (!block) { return; }

        function sync() {
            var temporary = status.value === 'temporary';
            block.hidden = !temporary;

            // Disabling matters as much as hiding: a hidden `required` field
            // blocks submission with a validation message nobody can see, and
            // a disabled field posts nothing for a permanent resident.
            block.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(function (field) {
                field.disabled = !temporary;
                var label = field.previousElementSibling;
                var isRequired = label && label.querySelector && label.querySelector('.req');
                field.required = temporary && !!isRequired;
            });
        }
        status.addEventListener('change', sync);
        sync();
    });
})();

        function fillPersonRows(field, rows) {
            var group = infoModal
                ? infoModal.querySelector('[data-person-rows="' + field + '"]')
                : null;
            if (!group) { return; }

            var template = group.querySelector('[data-person-row]');
            if (!template) { return; }

            // Selects as well as inputs: courtesy title and gender are
            // dropdowns, and clearing only the text boxes would leave a
            // previous person's title stuck on a fresh row.
            blank.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach(function (control) {

// Auto-fill the read-only Age field from the selected birthdate.
// Age is display-only and never submitted — it is always derived
// from birthdate so it cannot go stale in the database.
(function () {
    function computeAge(value) {
        if (!value) { return ''; }
        var parts = value.split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) { return ''; }

        var born = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        if (isNaN(born.getTime())) { return ''; }

        var today = new Date();
        if (born > today) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }

        var age = today.getFullYear() - born.getFullYear();
        var monthDiff = today.getMonth() - born.getMonth();

        // Subtract a year if this year's birthday has not happened yet
        if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < born.getDate())) {
            age = age - 1;
        }

        if (age < 0) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }
        return age === 1 ? '1 year old' : age + ' years old';
    }

    function updateAddAgeDisplay() {
        var birthdateInput = document.getElementById('birthdate');
        var ageField = document.getElementById('age_display');
        if (!birthdateInput || !ageField) { return; }
        ageField.value = computeAge(birthdateInput.value);
    }

    function updateEditAgeDisplay() {
        var birthdateInput = document.getElementById('edit_birthdate');
        var ageField = document.getElementById('edit_age_display');
        if (!birthdateInput || !ageField) { return; }
        ageField.value = computeAge(birthdateInput.value);
    }

    window.updateEditAgeDisplay = updateEditAgeDisplay;

    var addBirthdateInput = document.getElementById('birthdate');
    if (addBirthdateInput) {
        addBirthdateInput.addEventListener('change', updateAddAgeDisplay);
        addBirthdateInput.addEventListener('input', updateAddAgeDisplay);
        updateAddAgeDisplay();
    }

    var editBirthdateInput = document.getElementById('edit_birthdate');
    if (editBirthdateInput) {
        editBirthdateInput.addEventListener('change', updateEditAgeDisplay);
        editBirthdateInput.addEventListener('input', updateEditAgeDisplay);
        updateEditAgeDisplay();
    }
})();

    // Shows the years/months/days total as soon as a date is picked, and warns
    // when Permanent is chosen too early. The server re-checks this; the

    var MIN_MONTHS = 6;

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-residency-start]').forEach(function (dateField) {
        var scope = dateField.closest('.modal-box') || document;
        var status = scope.querySelector('[name="residency_status"]');

        // because the status there is only changed through the Make Permanent
        // / Revert button. Either way this needs to know which status applies.
        function currentStatus() {
            if (status) { return status.value; }
            return badge.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === 'temporary' ? 'temporary' : 'permanent';
        }

        function describe(start, today) {
            var years = today.getFullYear() - start.getFullYear();
            var months = today.getMonth() - start.getMonth();
            var days = today.getDate() - start.getDate();

            if (days < 0) {
                months--;
                days += new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
            }
            if (months < 0) {
                years--;
                months += 12;
            }

            var parts = [];
            if (years)  { parts.push(years + ' year' + (years === 1 ? '' : 's')); }
            if (months) { parts.push(months + ' month' + (months === 1 ? '' : 's')); }
            if (days)   { parts.push(days + ' day' + (days === 1 ? '' : 's')); }

            return {
                totalMonths: years * 12 + months,
                text: parts.length ? parts.join(', ') : 'less than a day'
            };
        }

        function sync() {
            note.classList.remove('field-hint-warning');

            if (!dateField.value) {
                note.textContent = 'Permanent status requires at least ' + MIN_MONTHS + ' months of residence.';
                dateField.setCustomValidity('');
                return;
            }

            var start = new Date(dateField.value + 'T00:00:00');
            var today = new Date();
            today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

            if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || start > today) {
                note.textContent = 'Pick a date that is not in the future.';
                note.classList.add('field-hint-warning');
                dateField.setCustomValidity('The residency start date cannot be in the future.');
                return;
            }

            var span = describe(start, today);

            if (currentStatus() === 'permanent' && span.totalMonths < MIN_MONTHS) {
                note.textContent = 'Residing here for ' + span.text + '. That is under the '
                    + MIN_MONTHS + '-month minimum, so this person cannot be recorded as Permanent yet.'
                    + ' Choose Temporary and change the status later.';
                note.classList.add('field-hint-warning');
                dateField.setCustomValidity('A permanent resident needs at least ' + MIN_MONTHS + ' months of residence.');
            } else {
                note.textContent = 'Residing here for ' + span.text + '.';
                dateField.setCustomValidity('');
            }
        }

        dateField.addEventListener('input', sync);
        if (status) { status.addEventListener('change', sync); }

        var input = other.querySelector('input');
        if (input) {
            input.required = custom;
            if (!custom) { input.value = ''; }
        }
    }

    select.addEventListener('change', sync);
    sync();

/*
 * Keep the read-only Age box in step with the birthdate.
 *
 * Age is shown, never submitted: it is derived from the date each time so it
 * cannot drift out of date in the database the way a stored number would.
 * The server prints the opening value, so the field is already correct if
 * this script never runs.
 */
(function () {
    var birthdate = document.getElementById('birthdate');
    var ageField = document.getElementById('age_display');
    if (!birthdate || !ageField) { return; }

    function describeAge(value) {
        if (!value) { return ''; }

        var parts = value.split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) { return ''; }

        var born = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        if (isNaN(born.getTime())) { return ''; }

        var today = new Date();
        if (born > today) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }

        var age = today.getFullYear() - born.getFullYear();
        var monthDiff = today.getMonth() - born.getMonth();

        // This year's birthday has not come round yet.
        if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < born.getDate())) {
            age = age - 1;
        }

        if (age < 0) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }
        return age === 1 ? '1 year old' : age + ' years old';
    }

    function sync() {
        ageField.value = describeAge(birthdate.value);
    }

    birthdate.addEventListener('change', sync);
    birthdate.addEventListener('input', sync);
    sync();
})();

/*
 * Keep the read-only Age box in step with the birthdate.
 *
 * Age is shown, never submitted: it is derived from the date each time so it
 * cannot drift out of date in the database the way a stored number would.
 * The server prints the opening value, so the field is already correct if
 * this script never runs.
 */
(function () {
    var birthdate = document.getElementById('birthdate');
    var ageField = document.getElementById('age_display');
    if (!birthdate || !ageField) { return; }

    function describeAge(value) {
        if (!value) { return ''; }

        var parts = value.split('-');
        if (parts.length !== 3) { return ''; }

        var born = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        if (isNaN(born.getTime())) { return ''; }

        var today = new Date();
        if (born > today) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }

        var age = today.getFullYear() - born.getFullYear();
        var monthDiff = today.getMonth() - born.getMonth();

        // This year's birthday has not come round yet.
        if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < born.getDate())) {
            age = age - 1;
        }

        if (age < 0) { return 'Invalid birthdate'; }
        return age === 1 ? '1 year old' : age + ' years old';
    }

    function sync() {
        ageField.value = describeAge(birthdate.value);
    }

    birthdate.addEventListener('change', sync);
    birthdate.addEventListener('input', sync);
    sync();
})();

// AJAX-loaded dashboard statistics (fetched from ajax_stats.php, rendered with Chart.js)
var CHART_FONT = { family: "'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif", size: 12 };
var SERIES = ['#1d6f5e', '#2f6da9', '#f2a541', '#75c79d', '#8a94a6', '#c0392b'];
var INK_MUTED = '#6b7c76';
var INK = '#223028';
var GRIDLINE = '#e9efec';

var pieLegend = {
    position: 'bottom',
    labels: {
        usePointStyle: true,
        pointStyle: 'circle',
        boxWidth: 8,
        boxHeight: 8,
        padding: 14,
        color: INK,
        font: CHART_FONT
    }
};

/**
 * Writes a headline figure into the hole of a doughnut, the way the
 * reference dashboards put an overall score at the centre of the ring.
 * Purely a drawing step — it reads the value it is given and nothing else.
 */
function centreText(main, sub) {
    return {
        id: 'centreText-' + main + sub,
        afterDraw: function (chart) {
            var area = chart.chartArea;
            if (!area) { return; }
            var ctx = chart.ctx;
            var x = (area.left + area.right) / 2;
            var meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(0);
            // A half-doughnut's visual centre sits at its flat edge, not
            // the middle of the box, so anchor to the arc instead.
            var y = (meta && meta.data && meta.data[0])
                ? meta.data[0].y
                : (area.top + area.bottom) / 2;
            var half = chart.options.circumference === 180;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillStyle = INK;
            ctx.font = '700 26px ' + CHART_FONT.family;
            ctx.textBaseline = half ? 'bottom' : 'alphabetic';
            ctx.fillText(main, x, half ? y - 4 : y + 4);

            ctx.fillStyle = INK_MUTED;
            ctx.font = '600 11px ' + CHART_FONT.family;
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(sub, x, half ? y + 2 : y + 12);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    };
}

/** Draws the value at the end of each horizontal bar. */
var barValueLabels = {
    id: 'barValueLabels',
    afterDatasetsDraw: function (chart) {
        var ctx = chart.ctx;
        chart.data.datasets.forEach(function (dataset, index) {
            var meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(index);
            if (meta.hidden) { return; }
            meta.data.forEach(function (element, i) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.font = '700 11px ' + CHART_FONT.family;
                ctx.fillStyle = INK_MUTED;
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText(dataset.data[i], element.x + 7, element.y);
                ctx.restore();
            });
        });
    }
};

// Shortens long survey titles so the plot area keeps its room.
// The untruncated title is still shown in the tooltip.
function shortLabel(text, max) {
    return text.length > max ? text.slice(0, max - 1) + '\u2026' : text;
}

            .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function (data) {
                var chart = window.trendChart;
                if (!chart || !data.response_trend) { return; }
                chart.data.labels = data.response_trend.map(function (d) { return d.label; });
                chart.data.datasets[0].data = data.response_trend.map(function (d) { return d.value; });
                chart.update();
            })
            .catch(function () { /* leave the previous view in place */ });
    }

    apply.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!fromInput.value || !toInput.value) { return; }
        load(fromInput.value, toInput.value);
    });

    reset.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var to = new Date();
        var from = new Date();
        from.setDate(from.getDate() - 29);
        toInput.value = to.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        fromInput.value = from.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        load(fromInput.value, toInput.value);
    });
})();

// AJAX-loaded dashboard statistics (fetched from ajax_stats.php, rendered with Chart.js)
var CHART_FONT = { family: "'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif", size: 12 };
var SERIES = ['#1d6f5e', '#2f6da9', '#f2a541', '#75c79d', '#8a94a6', '#c0392b'];
var INK_MUTED = '#6b7c76';
var INK = '#223028';
var GRIDLINE = '#e9efec';

var pieLegend = {
    position: 'bottom',
    labels: {
        usePointStyle: true,
        pointStyle: 'circle',
        boxWidth: 8,
        boxHeight: 8,
        padding: 14,
        color: INK,
        font: CHART_FONT
    }
};

/**
 * Writes a headline figure into the hole of a doughnut, the way the
 * reference dashboards put an overall score at the centre of the ring.
 * Purely a drawing step — it reads the value it is given and nothing else.
 */
function centreText(main, sub) {
    return {
        id: 'centreText-' + main + sub,
        afterDraw: function (chart) {
            var area = chart.chartArea;
            if (!area) { return; }
            var ctx = chart.ctx;
            var x = (area.left + area.right) / 2;
            var meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(0);
            // A half-doughnut's visual centre sits at its flat edge, not
            // the middle of the box, so anchor to the arc instead.
            var y = (meta && meta.data && meta.data[0])
                ? meta.data[0].y
                : (area.top + area.bottom) / 2;
            var half = chart.options.circumference === 180;

            ctx.save();
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillStyle = INK;
            ctx.font = '700 26px ' + CHART_FONT.family;
            ctx.textBaseline = half ? 'bottom' : 'alphabetic';
            ctx.fillText(main, x, half ? y - 4 : y + 4);

            ctx.fillStyle = INK_MUTED;
            ctx.font = '600 11px ' + CHART_FONT.family;
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(sub, x, half ? y + 2 : y + 12);
            ctx.restore();
        }
    };
}

/** Draws the value at the end of each horizontal bar. */
var barValueLabels = {
    id: 'barValueLabels',
    afterDatasetsDraw: function (chart) {
        var ctx = chart.ctx;
        chart.data.datasets.forEach(function (dataset, index) {
            var meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(index);
            if (meta.hidden) { return; }
            meta.data.forEach(function (element, i) {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.font = '700 11px ' + CHART_FONT.family;
                ctx.fillStyle = INK_MUTED;
                ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
                ctx.fillText(dataset.data[i], element.x + 7, element.y);
                ctx.restore();
            });
        });
    }
};

// Shortens long survey titles so the plot area keeps its room.
// The untruncated title is still shown in the tooltip.
function shortLabel(text, max) {
    return text.length > max ? text.slice(0, max - 1) + '\u2026' : text;
}

// ---- Participation gauge: a value the page already computed ----
(function () {
    var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-participation');
    if (!canvas) { return; }
    var pct = 29;   // already clamped to 0-100 in PHP
    var shown = Math.min(Math.max(pct, 0), 100);
    new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
            labels: ['Responded', 'Remaining'],
            datasets: [{
                data: [shown, 100 - shown],
                backgroundColor: [SERIES[0], '#e4ebe8'],
                borderWidth: 0,
                spacing: 0
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            circumference: 180,
            rotation: 270,
            cutout: '74%',
            layout: { padding: { bottom: 6 } },
            plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { enabled: false } }
        },
        plugins: [centreText(pct + '%', 'of residents')]
    });
})();

fetch('ajax_stats.php')
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (data) {
        // ---- Responses per survey: horizontal bars with end labels ----
        var responsesCanvas = document.getElementById('chart-responses');
        if (responsesCanvas && data.responses_per_survey) {
            var maxValue = Math.max.apply(null, data.responses_per_survey.map(function (d) { return d.value; }).concat([1]));
            new Chart(responsesCanvas, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: data.responses_per_survey.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Responses',
                        data: data.responses_per_survey.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        backgroundColor: SERIES[0],
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        maxBarThickness: 22
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    indexAxis: 'y',
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    layout: { padding: { right: 30 } },
                    plugins: {
                        legend: { display: false },
                        tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                                title: function (items) { return items[0].label; }
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            beginAtZero: true,
                            suggestedMax: maxValue,
                            grid: { color: GRIDLINE, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: { precision: 0, color: INK_MUTED, font: CHART_FONT }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: {
                                color: INK_MUTED,
                                font: CHART_FONT,
                                autoSkip: false,
                                callback: function (value) {
                                    return shortLabel(this.getLabelForValue(value), 18);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                plugins: [barValueLabels]
            });
        }

        // ---- Daily response trend ----
        var trendCanvas = document.getElementById('chart-trend');
        if (trendCanvas && data.response_trend) {
            window.trendChart = new Chart(trendCanvas, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: data.response_trend.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Responses',
                        data: data.response_trend.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        borderColor: SERIES[0],
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(29, 111, 94, 0.14)',
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.35,
                        pointRadius: 0,
                        pointHoverRadius: 4,
                        borderWidth: 2
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: {
                                color: INK_MUTED,
                                font: CHART_FONT,
                                maxRotation: 0,
                                autoSkip: true,
                                maxTicksLimit: 8
                            }
                        },
                        y: {
                            beginAtZero: true,
                            ticks: { precision: 0, color: INK_MUTED, font: CHART_FONT },
                            grid: { color: GRIDLINE, drawBorder: false }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // ---- Survey status, with the total in the ring ----
        var statusCanvas = document.getElementById('chart-survey-status');
        if (statusCanvas && data.survey_status) {
            var statusTotal = data.survey_status.reduce(function (sum, d) { return sum + d.value; }, 0);
            new Chart(statusCanvas, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: data.survey_status.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        data: data.survey_status.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        backgroundColor: [SERIES[0], SERIES[5], SERIES[4]],
                        borderWidth: 0,
                        spacing: 0
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '66%',
                    layout: { padding: { top: 4, bottom: 4 } },
                    plugins: { legend: pieLegend }
                },
                plugins: [centreText(String(statusTotal), 'surveys')]
            });
        }

        // ---- Residency mix ----
        var residencyCanvas = document.getElementById('chart-residency');
        if (residencyCanvas && data.residency_mix) {
            var residencyTotal = data.residency_mix.reduce(function (sum, d) { return sum + d.value; }, 0);
            new Chart(residencyCanvas, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: data.residency_mix.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        data: data.residency_mix.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        backgroundColor: [SERIES[0], SERIES[2]],
                        borderWidth: 0,
                        spacing: 0
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '66%',
                    layout: { padding: { top: 4, bottom: 4 } },
                    plugins: { legend: pieLegend }
                },
                plugins: [centreText(String(residencyTotal), 'residents')]
            });
        }

        // ---- Question types: plain bars, no canvas needed ----
        var mixHost = document.getElementById('question-mix');
        if (mixHost) {
            var mix = data.question_types || [];
            if (!mix.length) {
                mixHost.innerHTML = '<div class="db-empty">No questions have been added to a survey yet.</div>';
            } else {
                var mixMax = Math.max.apply(null, mix.map(function (d) { return d.value; }).concat([1]));
                var rows = mix.map(function (d) {
                    var width = Math.round((d.value / mixMax) * 100);
                    return '<div class="db-bar-row">'
                         +   '<div class="db-bar-head">'
                         +     '<span class="db-bar-label">' + d.label + '</span>'
                         +     '<span class="db-bar-value">' + d.value + '</span>'
                         +   '</div>'
                         +   '<div class="db-bar-track"><span class="db-bar-fill" style="width:' + width + '%"></span></div>'
                         + '</div>';
                }).join('');
                mixHost.innerHTML = '<div class="db-bars">' + rows + '</div>';
            }
        }

        /* ================= Resident demographics =================
           Each canvas is only present when there are residents on file, so
           every block checks for its canvas first and quietly does nothing
           when the section was skipped. */

        // Small helpers, so six charts do not become six near-identical
        // blocks of options that can drift apart one edit at a time.
        function verticalBars(canvas, rows, colour) {
            if (!canvas || !rows || !rows.length) { return; }
            new Chart(canvas, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: rows.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Residents',
                        data: rows.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        backgroundColor: colour,
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        maxBarThickness: 46
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: { color: INK_MUTED, font: CHART_FONT }
                        },
                        y: {
                            beginAtZero: true,
                            grid: { color: GRIDLINE, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: { precision: 0, color: INK_MUTED, font: CHART_FONT }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function horizontalBars(canvas, rows, colour) {
            if (!canvas || !rows || !rows.length) { return; }
            new Chart(canvas, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: rows.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        label: 'Residents',
                        data: rows.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        backgroundColor: colour,
                        borderRadius: 4,
                        maxBarThickness: 20
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    indexAxis: 'y',
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    layout: { padding: { right: 30 } },
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
                    scales: {
                        x: {
                            beginAtZero: true,
                            grid: { color: GRIDLINE, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: { precision: 0, color: INK_MUTED, font: CHART_FONT }
                        },
                        y: {
                            grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false },
                            ticks: {
                                color: INK_MUTED,
                                font: CHART_FONT,
                                autoSkip: false,
                                callback: function (value) {
                                    return shortLabel(this.getLabelForValue(value), 18);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
                plugins: [barValueLabels]
            });
        }

        function ringChart(canvas, rows) {
            if (!canvas || !rows || !rows.length) { return; }
            var total = rows.reduce(function (sum, d) { return sum + d.value; }, 0);
            new Chart(canvas, {
                type: 'doughnut',
                data: {
                    labels: rows.map(function (d) { return d.label; }),
                    datasets: [{
                        data: rows.map(function (d) { return d.value; }),
                        backgroundColor: SERIES.slice(0, rows.length),
                        borderWidth: 0
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    cutout: '62%',
                    plugins: {
                        legend: pieLegend,
                        tooltip: {
                            callbacks: {
                                label: function (item) {
                                    var share = total ? Math.round((item.parsed / total) * 100) : 0;
                                    return item.label + ': ' + item.parsed + ' (' + share + '%)';
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        verticalBars(document.getElementById('chart-age'), data.age_groups, SERIES[0]);
        ringChart(document.getElementById('chart-gender'), data.gender_mix);
        ringChart(document.getElementById('chart-priority'), data.priority_groups);
        horizontalBars(document.getElementById('chart-occupation'), data.occupations, SERIES[1]);
        horizontalBars(document.getElementById('chart-purok'), data.purok_mix, SERIES[3]);
        verticalBars(document.getElementById('chart-household'), data.household, SERIES[2]);
    })
    .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load dashboard chart data', err);
        var mixHost = document.getElementById('question-mix');
        if (mixHost) {
            mixHost.innerHTML = '<div class="db-empty">Chart data could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.</div>';
        }
    });



// Re-fetch just the trend series when a different period is chosen. Nothing
// else on the dashboard depends on the window, so the page need not reload.
(function () {
    var apply = document.getElementById('trend-apply');
    var reset = document.getElementById('trend-reset');
    if (!apply) { return; }

    var fromInput = document.getElementById('trend-from');
    var toInput = document.getElementById('trend-to');

    function load(from, to) {
        fetch('ajax_stats.php?from=' + encodeURIComponent(from) + '&to=' + encodeURIComponent(to))
            .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
            .then(function (data) {
                var chart = window.trendChart;
                if (!chart || !data.response_trend) { return; }
                chart.data.labels = data.response_trend.map(function (d) { return d.label; });
                chart.data.datasets[0].data = data.response_trend.map(function (d) { return d.value; });
                chart.update();
            })
            .catch(function () { /* leave the previous view in place */ });
    }

    apply.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (!fromInput.value || !toInput.value) { return; }
        load(fromInput.value, toInput.value);
    });

    reset.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var to = new Date();
        var from = new Date();
        from.setDate(from.getDate() - 29);
        toInput.value = to.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        fromInput.value = from.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        load(fromInput.value, toInput.value);
    });
})();
